> **solely** in `memory/confidential/registry.md` and are never restated here or in any
> brief, log, or chat.

- **Type:** confidential footprint / consolidation decision. Board-level, pre-decision.
- **Owner:** Ray, with CFO [Priya Deshmukh](../people/priya-deshmukh.md) (financial case) and COO
